Spider Proxy is a mobile HTTP/HTTPS packet capture and network debugging tool which supports directly viewing/modifying the HTTP (S) requests and responses of the iOS system without connecting to a computer. Spider Proxy supports the export of network request records and can also perform custom HTTP (S) network debugging, including URL redirection, custom header, etc. 

Upgrade to Spider Proxy VIP and support 4 secondary devices simultaneously, along with one click data upload and sharing between devices. VIP also allows the user to set separate authorization rules for devices as needed and revoke authorization at any time.

How it works
Spider Proxy will create a VPN configuration on the device. When packet capture is enabled, the Spider Proxy will start a local HTTP proxy in the VPN process, and all HTTP traffic will be forwarded to this local proxy through the VPN, enabling all network access requests on the local machine to be completed through it, thereby hijacking and analyzing all HTTP (S) requests and responses.
